reasoning: On the season so far the Thunder are the stronger team; with home court the Thunder start about 1 points better, in a game of about 230 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Heat.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Heat win 50 times in 100; most games like this end between 204 and 252 total points.
